title: Lease recovery
text: A lease is temporary permission. A worker must renew before expiry. A fencing token lets a downstream resource reject an older worker.

title: Cache snapshots
text: Publish a cache snapshot only after every resource is saved. A failed candidate must not replace the previous complete snapshot.

title: Readiness
text: Readiness decides whether a pod should receive service traffic. Liveness and readiness have different responsibilities.
